description: This file defines interfaces, macros, and data structures for interrupt request (IRQ) handling in an AUTOSAR-based Arctic Core platform, including ISR declaration macros, initialization, and control functions.

methods.name: Irq_Entry
methods.description: Handles the entry point for IRQ processing, with different parameters depending on configuration.

methods.name: Irq_GenerateSoftInt
methods.description: Generates a software interrupt for a given vector.

methods.name: Irq_GetCurrentPriority
methods.description: Retrieves the current interrupt priority for a specified CPU.

methods.name: Irq_SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority for a specific interrupt vector on a CPU.

methods.name: Irq_EnableVector
methods.description: Enables a specific interrupt vector on a core with a given priority.

methods.name: Irq_EOI
methods.description: Ends the processing of an interrupt (End Of Interrupt).
